# Test that the compiler limits the number of reported errors by default (maxErrors=20),
# and that the -e flag removes this limit.

# Without -e, should stop at 20 errors and print "too many errors".
! go tool compile main.go
stdout 'too many errors'
stdout -count=20 'undefined: e'

# With -e, should report all errors (31 in this case).
! go tool compile -e main.go
! stdout 'too many errors'
stdout -count=31 'undefined: e'

-- main.go --
package main

func main() {
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
	_ = e
}
